messages:
miguel-oncall: Pager: multiple encoder pods in prod-gpu are CrashLoopBackOff after the 03:14 deploy. Observed ~40% pod churn and higher latencies. Raising to pager. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-2117. Severity: P1. Owner: miguel-oncall. Notify: #incidents, #eng-oncall.
devin_sre: looking at k8s events — I see repeated OOMKilled + eviction bursts on nodes gpu-03, gpu-04. HPA scaled down unexpectedly to 1 replica right before pods restarted.
miguel-oncall: timeline? did rollout include config change to requests/limits or HPA target?
tara_prodeng: we pushed a configmap flip for encoder memory tuning (memoryRequests set to 6Gi -> 4Gi) as part of the rollout to reduce bin packing. It was in the manifest change group but not flagged for rollout freeze.
alice_support: customer-impact: a few mid-tier customers reported increased 503s on embeddings endpoints starting ~03:18. CS is collecting affected org IDs.
miguel-oncall: OK kill the rollout, revert the configmap, and scale HPA minReplicas back up. I’m going to hit the feature-flag kill switch for the new encoder variant.
tara_prodeng: deploying revert now. rolling back configmap 'encoder-tuning:v12' -> 'v11'.
deploy-bot: Revert applied: configmap encoder-tuning:v11 restored by tara_prodeng. CI/CD run id 654321.
devin_sre: applying HPA override: setting minReplicas=3, maxReplicas=12 temporarily on prod-gpu/encoder-deployment.
miguel-oncall: manual scale to 4 replicas to speed recovery.
cluster-monitor: Node gpu-04 is reporting kernel OOM events; pods evicted due to node pressure. Suggest cordon gpu-04 and drain after stabilizing.
devin_sre: cordoned gpu-04. scheduling pods to gpu-05. Investigating host-level logs; looks like a rogue sidecar from canary had memory leak, accounted for ~10-12Gi.
tara_prodeng: that sidecar was part of ephemeral profiler we turned on in the canary flag. I thought it was scoped to canary-only but seems to have leaked into the rollout. Enabling kill-switch for profiler flag.
miguel-oncall: good. Resume recovery steps: 1) scale encoder to 6 replicas 2) ensure HPA min=3 3) confirm no more profiler sidecars deployed 4) monitor 503 rate 5) update CS with impacted list.
alice_support: forwarding list to customers now. Will post update to affected customers within 30m.
devin_sre: replicas are stabilizing. CrashLoopBackOff count down from 18->3. Latency on embeddings down to baseline after new pods warm up.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-2117 status: mitigation in progress. Assigned to miguel-oncall.
miguel-oncall: postmortem notes to capture: mis-scoped profiler flag, configmap mem reduction without canary matrix check, HPA min too low for transient eviction. Also need clearer pre-rollout node pressure check.
tara_prodeng: creating rollback changelog and adding a guard in the release pipeline to block configmap memory decreases without a perf canary in the same region.
alice_support: CS note: sent interim message to affected customers, offering extended retry window. No customer data loss reported.
devin_sre: recommending follow-ups: autoscaler healthcheck (prevent scale-to-one during rollouts), sidecar whitelist for prod nodes, and node pressure alert tuning.
miguel-oncall: thanks. Handing to devin_sre for cleanup and to tara_prodeng for release gating followups. If anyone sees re-escalation, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
customer-success-bot: Affected org IDs: org-389, org-112, org-447. Escalated to account team.
incident-bot: INC-2026-2117 moved to status: monitor. Target followup meeting scheduled in 2 hours.
